human_scope_review: Owner approved resolving all stale PR conflicts. This single reviewable change combines rebased PR #229 (guarded legacy fresh install pull refresh parity) and PR #228 (24 route read-only SQLCipher preflight). All current main SMS, biometric, merchant, goals and budget code is retained; no production SQLCipher activation, money movement or migration is permitted. This release candidate also fixes independent exact-head Android emulator disk exhaustion: the same encrypted DB job fails on a hosted runner before finance tests when userdata exceeds available disk. Retain the mandatory physical emulator test while reducing AVD disk size to 3072MB and removing nonessential hosted runner toolchains.
user_requested_changes: Reconcile conflicted PR #229 onto current main without replacing newer unrelated finance, SMS, budget, biometric or merchant UI fixes.
Allow first-install guarded-legacy pull-to-refresh when genuinely absent empty ledger or categories are valid and preserve the same default categories as ordinary startup.
Fail closed on absent or corrupt authoritative SQLCipher financial fields, keeping existing money records unchanged and detecting malformed source data.
Preserve the existing independent named-budget refresh projection and all unrelated Home and Widget finance state.
Add regression tests proving legacy default parity and encrypted/malformed source refusal on the exact updated PR head.
Resolve the outdated conflicting PR #228 against current main while preserving all later finance, SMS, widget, backup, biometric and locale code.
Check each canonical finance route before ever binding an already active encrypted SQLCipher source and reject any route without audited witness.
Keep the preflight strictly read-only and incapable of automatically activating SQLCipher or switching the authoritative ledger.
Preserve current guarded-legacy startup and require existing OS-backed key, verified source digest and native bridge before any encrypted read.
Add deterministic 24-route, missing-key, missing-witness, incomplete-audit, immutable report and main-wiring regression tests.
Remove the shared GitHub hosted-runner Android encrypted DB emulator disk-exhaustion CI blocker without changing finance logic, test assertions or marking emulator verification skipped.
